task.goal: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "Folk Favourites 547" with the following songs, in order: Shadows of Time, Distant Memories
task.final_summary: I created the playlist "Folk Favourites 547" in Retro Music and added both songs in the order you gave: Shadows of Time first, then Distant Memories. The playlist screen shows 2 Songs and 09:06 total duration, with the two tracks listed in that order.

steps.note: Observe current screen and launch Retro Music
Launch Retro Music and observe its main screen
Observe Retro Music home screen
Open Playlists tab
Tap More options to find Create playlist
Tap New playlist and enter name
Type playlist name
Tap Create and verify playlist appears
Open the new playlist and add songs
Open playlist menu to add songs
Close menu and open Songs tab
Tap Songs tab
Back to playlists screen then open Songs tab
Open Songs tab to find the two songs
Open Shadows of Time menu and choose Add to playlist
Choose Add to playlist for Shadows of Time
Select Folk Favourites 547 to add Shadows of Time
Open Distant Memories menu and choose Add to playlist
Tap Add to playlist
Select playlist to add Distant Memories, then verify playlist contents
Open Playlists tab and the playlist to verify songs and order
Open playlist and map songs to confirm order
Map playlist rows to confirm 2 songs in order
Task complete
